svg.title: Tensorus Unified Platform Architecture
svg.desc: External AI agents via MCP, Python SDK and Xarray clients, and the localized Web Console connect over bounded HTTPS and OIDC/API keys to the Tensorus control and execution plane, backed by a transactional PostgreSQL catalog, immutable S3 Zarr v3 tensor storage, and lease-fenced compute workers.
